Package dev.px.core.config

Interface ConfigSection

All Known Implementing Classes:
AccountService, HudService, SettingsSection, SocialService, ToggleableSection
public interface ConfigSection
One addressable block of a config file.

Modules are a section, HUD elements are a section, the theme is a section, and a client can add its own. Sections are read independently, so a section that fails to load, or one written by a build that had a feature this one does not, leaves the rest of the config intact.
